label: The basic formula
subgoals: Convert the die area to the units of the defect density
Multiply area by density for the expected defect count
Exponentiate the negative count for the yield

label: Inferring defect density
subgoals: Take the negative log of the observed yield
Divide by the die area in square centimetres
Separate parametric losses before quoting a defect density

label: Critical area
subgoals: Compute expected faults per mechanism as critical area times density
Add the expected faults across mechanisms
Exponentiate the negative total for the yield
